verdict.rationale: Omarchy has some CLI tooling (e.g. omarchy-snapshot create) and a documented omarchy-cli manual page, and ships AI agent harnesses (OpenCode, Claude Code) that are themselves CLI-based, suggesting AI-native CLI usage is possible. However, no first-party evidence describes an 'official CLI' purpose-built for AI-native workflows (e.g. scripting/automation hooks, machine-readable output) beyond a bare manual page link. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the omarchy-cli's AI-native features, examples of AI agents invoking it, and independent corroboration of its use in agentic workflows.
